annotations.title: Find a guild by the start of its name

description: Guilds whose name starts with what you typed, each with its realm, faction, how many characters the addon saw in it, and the count and date of its agreed boss kills. A guild is listed once its members' uploads agree on a kill (2 installs reporting the same guild and boss), once its officers published a board, or once a character was seen in it. Guild names only, never a member's name, and a guild that asked to be hidden is left out. Members seen are counted only when the player pages are connected; otherwise the count is unrecorded, not zero. Reads Everloot's current authorized public corpus when connected. Missing or unavailable data is reported explicitly.

query.description: The start of the guild's name, 2 to 24 characters.

name: guild_search

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

faction.description: Null until a kill or a board names it.

kills.description: Agreed boss kills, members' and officers' together.

latestKillAt.description: The newest agreed kill, ISO; null without a timed kill.

membersSeen.description: Characters the addon saw in the guild; null when the player pages are not connected, which is not zero.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.

title: Find a guild by the start of its name
